Hotels in Reinickendorf: quiet in the green north, near the Tegeler See

Reinickendorf lies in the north of Berlin - the Tegeler See, the Tegeler Forst and Frohnau. You stay quietly in the green and are still in Mitte in around 20 minutes on the U6. Mid-range and family hotels dominate the district.

Note: the former Tegel airport (TXL) has been closed since 2020 - Berlin's airport today is BER in the southeast. Reinickendorf offers nature, water and quiet residential streets instead.

Who is Reinickendorf right for?

For families and travelers who need quiet, want to stay in the green but reach the center quickly. The U6 gets you to Mitte in around 20 minutes; all around, the Tegeler See and the Tegeler Forst await.

The north is also relaxed for travelers with a car - parking is far easier to find here than in the inner city.

Which hotel do we recommend?

The Best Western Hotel am Borsigturm sits in the redeveloped Borsigwerke site, a historic industrial monument, and offers a pool, sauna and conference area. Via the U6 (Borsigwerke station) you are at Alexanderplatz in about 25 minutes - a solid, family-friendly choice with good value for money.

What is there to do in northern Berlin?

Walks and boat trips on the Tegeler See, hiking in the Tegeler Forst, a detour to Tegel Palace and the Frohnau Pagoda. In summer the north is a relaxed recreation area away from the tourist flows.

Frequently asked questions

Are there still airport hotels in Reinickendorf? +

Tegel airport (TXL) has been closed since November 2020; the site is being redeveloped as the "Urban Tech Republic". If you want a hotel near the airport today, book toward BER in the southeast of Berlin.

How do I get from Reinickendorf to the center? +

The U6 reaches Mitte in around 20 minutes; Alexanderplatz takes about 25–30 minutes with one change.

What does a hotel in Reinickendorf cost? +

Family and mid-range properties mostly sit at around €95–130 per night - fair for a quiet room in the green.

Does the district suit families? +

Yes - quiet, green, by the water and with family-friendly properties (pool, sauna). The good U-Bahn link makes trips into the center easy.
